rationale: Genome-wide CRISPRa screen (Calabrese set A, 3 guides per gene, dCas9-VP64) in N/TERT keratinocytes carrying a tdTomato tag in the last exon of COL7A1. The top 10% tdTomato cells were sorted and their guides compared with the plasmid library (GSM4970381 = sorted screen, GSM4970382 = sgRNA/plasmid), as in the paper, which converted guide fold changes over the plasmid into Z-scores. Activators of type VII collagen are enriched in the sort. One library per condition, so run_barcs.R uses the no-replicate path and calls are screening-level. The sorted-sample reads are the deposited Count column; plasmid reads were recovered exactly from refCPM (reads + 1 pseudocount times one constant; prepare.R, recovery_scales.json). Guides with no read in the sort are absent from the deposit, and 74 guides with an empty gene cell are dropped. Controls are the 477 guides labelled CONTROL (non-targeting).
